_about: History generator parameters for the Gable demo (B tenant). ~120 days. A Gable coder implements a deterministic seed that walks these parameters; the brief says rows themselves are out of scope, only the parameters.

_window._reason: Brief calls for about 120 days; one full quarter plus spring ramp.

_rounding_units: All money numbers in CAD dollars, two decimals. Quantities as floats, scale 4. Percentages as decimals (0.0 to 1.0).
_anchor_for_seasonal: Day 0 is the seed anchor date (set by DEMO_DISPATCH_DATE). Day 60 is the spring peak; day 100 begins fall easing; day 120 is mid-fall slow.

KEL-MAIN._reason: Kelowna Main is the big yard. Counter sales average ~38 weekdays; Saturday adds contractor pickup and DIY walk-in traffic.

WK._reason: West Kelowna is mid-size; deck and fence running higher because of the West Side subdivision builds.

LK._reason: Lake Country outpost is small but seasonal heavy (lake property lawns, snow).

weekday_seasonal_multiplier_curve._reason: Spring building season peaks around day 60; numbers ramp up over March and May, ease through August, and tail off heading into fall.

trade_vs_walkin_share._reason: WK runs heavier trade because of Peachland and Westside commercial; LK leans walk-in and DIY thanks to cottage country traffic.

quotes_per_day_by_yard._reason: Quote volume per yard tracks counter volume trade-weighted; PLATINUM accounts are most active on quotes.

quote_lifecycle._reason: Roughly 30 percent of sent quotes accept within a week; another 25 percent drift to expired at 30 days without response; small share gets rejected on price.

special_orders_per_week_per_yard._reason: Special orders are vendor-direct or non-stock millwork; three quarters demand a deposit; lead time around two weeks.

lead_time_draw._reason: Reads vendors.average_lead_time_days with noise. Local mills average 4 days; Pacific Northwest millwork 2 to 3 weeks.

purchase_orders_and_receipts._reason: Most POs close fully received; some partials carry for two weeks; short and over receipts reflect real yard receiving variance.

deliveries_by_truck_and_zone._reason: Two flatbeds and one boom at KEL-MAIN run most days; box truck and pickup fill in. POD photos almost always captured by site foreman.

average_payment_amount_per_invoice_share._reason: Net 30 invoices paid in full at 1.0; partials at 0.5 average. Some customers split pay across multiple checks.

ar_payments_aging_spread._reason: About half pay within terms; the tail carries the aging risk the credit report lives on; cheque share still meaningful in construction trades.

returns_and_credit_memos._reason: LBM yards see ~2.5 percent returns; damage + wrong product dominate. About half post (open), the rest stay draft.

_pct_change_at_event_distribution._reason: Commodity lumber swaps weekly based on mill list price and BC supply. Spike events 4 to 6 percent; routine moves 0.5 to 2 percent.

price_changes_on_commodity_lumber._reason: Commodity lumber and OSB prices move weekly; price_protection migration 081 frames these and the price change ledger carries them.

_seeding_seed: Each seed day rolls once off the workspace seed (11900021). One cash-register till session per yard per day if the day has counter sales. Apply zone_share for delivery stops.
